description:
We are looking for a Business Systems Analyst to join our IT Applications planning team. In this role, you will work in close partnership with Business and IT teams to design, develop, implement, and support the Anaplan planning platform and its capabilities, enabling enterprise-wide planning and collaboration.

You will be working directly with IT and business colleagues to decide on what needs to be built, timelines for work, and prioritizing efforts.


What you will be doing:

  • Design and deliver robust, implementable Anaplan solutions
  • Contribute to projects that implement new functionality and enhance existing Anaplan solutions
  • Build prototypes and proofs of concept for business requirements and translate them into effective operational solutions
  • Work directly with business users to gather comprehensive user stories and design and build solutions
  • Promote alignment with Anaplan model-building and application lifecycle management standards
  • Collaborate with technical teams to implement and automate inbound and outbound data interfaces
  • Manage assigned project work and support successful implementation, business adoption, and ongoing value realization

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related subject area
  • Anaplan Model Builder Level 3 certification required; Certified Master Anaplanner (CMA) and/or Certified Anaplan Solution Architect Professional credentials preferred
  • Relevant hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise performance management or demand planning solutions
  • Demonstrated experience applying The Anaplan Way throughout the complete project lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, model development, testing, user acceptance testing, deployment, documentation, and project closure
  • Demonstrable experience in translating complex business requirements into scalable, enterprise-level Anaplan solutions; Supply Chain planning experience is preferred
  • Deep understanding of Anaplan model architecture, formulas, and business logic, with strong knowledge of model-to-model integrations and Connected Planning
  • Experience of 5 or more years in a role supporting planning, building solutions, or consulting
  • Hands-on experience with Anaplan Data Orchestrator (ADO), Workflow, CoModeler and Optimizer
  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and committed to continuous skill development and learning
  • Good interpersonal skills and effective communication
  • Semiconductor or high-tech industry demand and supply chain planning knowledge preferred
  • Knowledge of SAP IBP, SAP BW, or other planning tools is a plus

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, and we have some of the most forward-thinking and growth-mindset people in the world working for us. Our best-in-class teams are rapidly growing, so if you are creative and autonomous with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
